findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, no test dependencies — the app cannot run any test in CI; only the external acceptance suite guards it.
findings.suggestion: Run `qwik add vitest` (Qwik's current first-party recommendation) and add a `test` script plus a vitest config reusing the qwikVite/qwikCity plugins.

findings.issue: The riskiest URL-state logic — page clamping (line 39), pagination slice (line 41), and homeUrl's omit-defaults rule (lines 51-58) — is untested; off-by-one or param-dropping regressions would pass.
findings.suggestion: Extract the loader's filter/paginate/serialize logic into a pure function in src/lib and unit-test it against representative query strings (type-only, generation-only, out-of-range page, empty q).

findings.issue: Nulls-last-in-both-directions comparator and the ascending/descending toggle with aria-sort (lines 92-102) are untested; a flipped sign or inverted toggle is invisible without a test.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test compareValues and the click-toggle state machine directly with mixed null/power/level rows.

findings.issue: Pure, dependency-free helpers (humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavorText reverse scan, collapseWhitespace) had zero tests written despite being the cheapest to cover.
findings.suggestion: Add a vitest spec for format.ts covering mr-mime, zero-padding, last-English-entry selection and \n/\f collapsing.

findings.issue: Moves aggregation (min-level dedupe, default game = highest order, METHOD_ORDER with alphabetical tail, level-then-name sort) is untested; any inversion silently changes every moves table.
findings.suggestion: Extract moves aggregation into a testable function taking pokemon.moves + version group order, and unit-test method ordering and level tie-breaks.

findings.issue: Promise-memoized cache with deliberate eviction of 404s and rejected fetches is untested; a broken eviction makes 'not found' permanent, violating the live-data requirement.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test apiGet with a mocked fetch: 404 then success on second call, 500 then success, ensuring the cache re-fetches.

findings.issue: Alternate-form exclusion (id >= 10000) is relied on by the move, ability and type loaders; a regression floods every list with Mega/alternate forms and no test would fail.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test isDefaultPokemonId boundaries and one loader (e.g. moves learned_by mapping) against fixture data containing id 10033.

findings.issue: Client-only behaviour (250 ms debounce, filter-change navigation, select onChange to ?game=...#moves at pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:268-271) has no component tests; Qwik resumability means QRL/handler breaks surface only on interaction.
findings.suggestion: Add a component test using @builder.io/qwik/testing createDOM (and QwikCityMockProvider) asserting the debounced input navigates with q= and resets page.

findings.issue: 404/not-found paths (status(404) in every loader plus the catch-all) are untested.
findings.suggestion: One e2e or route-loader test asserting a bogus slug (/pokemon/nonexistent) yields 404 and the NotFound heading.

findings.issue: EvoTree recursion handles branching chains (Eevee) with no test; a refactor of the recursive render can flatten or lose branches.
findings.suggestion: Test the toNode mapping against a fixture chain with multiple evolves_to levels.

summary: The app contains no tests whatsoever — no runner, no script, no test dependencies — so every score for this dimension is anchored to the no-tests case. Ironically the code is well set up for testing: data shaping lives in pure helpers and routeLoader$ bodies, so a vitest suite (Qwik's current recommendation via `qwik add vitest`) would be cheap to add. Until then, refactors of the filtering/pagination, moves aggregation, sort comparators, or API cache have no safety net once the acceptance suite is retired.
